sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of gepotidacin during breastfeeding. If a mother requires gepotidacin, it is not a reason to discontinue breastfeeding. Monitor the infant for diarrhea, vomiting, colic and adequate weight gain.
